let number_map = [
        ("zero", 0),
        ("one", 1),
        ("two", 2),
        ("three", 3),
        ("four", 4),
        ("five", 5),
        ("six", 6),
        ("seven", 7),
        ("eight", 8),
        ("nine", 9),
    ];

    let mut nums: Vec<(String, i32)> = numbers
        .split_whitespace()
        .map(|n| {
            let val = number_map.iter().find(|&&(name, _)| name == n).unwrap().1;
            (n.to_string(), val)
        })
        .collect();

    nums.sort_by_key(|&(_, v)| v);

    nums.into_iter()
        .map(|(s, _)| s)
        .collect::<Vec<String>>()
        .join(" ")
